referenceSources.description:
A Rosso Scuderia Ferrari 360 Challenge Stradale is presented from the rear, emphasizing its sporty design and racing pedigree. The factory Tricolore stripe runs along the center of the engine cover, while the black mesh panel houses the prancing horse badge and the “Challenge Stradale” script. Quad exhaust tips and circular taillights frame the lower section, complemented by a Morgan Cars specialist sales plate.

This 2004 model features a 3.6L V8 engine with 425 bhp, an F1 automatic gearbox, and extensive weight-saving measures including carbon fibre mirrors, racing seats, and a Plexiglas engine cover. With just 21,723 miles on the odometer, UK registration, and full Ferrari certification, it’s offered by Morgan Cars Ltd with export VAT qualification, delivery options, and flexible finance arrangements.
